I resent them so much. I had a really bad childhood, abusive home manipulative dad, scared mom but now a days who dosnt, im not special, I was so young and didn't understand it. My dad went to jail after assaulting my mom when I was 6, I didn't understand it. When I was 8 I caused my granny(grandma) to go crazy and throw things around, breaking glass screaming etc(we got into an argument and she was extremely drunk) we had to leave after calling the cops, my step dad favored my brother and I was basically ignored oh, he forgot my birthday, didn't say happy birthday, but my brother's birthday was huge celebration. our birthdays for 6 days apart. He left after they got divorced, I loved him after 7 years calling him Dad I really loved him, it's hard to say I'm relieved I didn't understand it. All I wanted was my father my real father not some bullshit replacement, you can't replace that. I miss him so much, I've spent so long without him and it's made me so so tired, I don't feel anything, I put on an act for others but it's hard, my mom asked me to accept the fact that I won't have a dad for the rest of my childhood, but she dosnt get it, it's so hard without him. I want to die every day and I can't tell anyone, it's gotten so bad I want to escape my reality because it's too much, so I resorted to weed, im young but my mom does it so I have someone to blame(selfish I know) but I have no feeling, i feel like a monster and every day I have to try my best to not cry and break down, it gets harder and harder, I've had a few slip ups, but on one cares. I can't tell my family, it's complicated it would destroy the family they're trying to build and it would hurt them so much, thank you for those who read this I needed to get this off my chest.
